source.title: Approval of Motions - January 2019
source.content:
After the recent voting, the proposed amendments to the Motions have been approved. The new complete set of Bylaws and Motions can be found on our [Documents page](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents) and a final set of the included changes can be found [here](https://github.com/thewca/wca-documents/pull/34/files). The Motions to be in force from January 1, 2019 have been compiled:

- [Motion 10.2019.1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2019.1%20-%20Competition%20Announcement%20Team.pdf): formally establishes through a Motion the WCA Competition Announcement Team and outlines the team's rights and duties.
- [Motion 20.2019.0](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/20.2019.0%20-%20Councils.pdf): gives a scope to WCA Councils.
- [Motion 20.2019.1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/20.2019.1%20-%20Advisory%20Council.pdf): formally establishes the WCA Advisory Council, together with its rights and duties.
- [Motion 2.2019.1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/02.2019.1%20-%20Definitions.pdf): adds missing definitions, new ones, and clarifications where necessary.
- [Motion 9.2019.1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/09.2019.1%20-%20Senior%20Delegates.pdf): restricts the possible applicants for Senior Delegate positions to Full Delegates only.
- [Motion 10.2019.0](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2019.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf): defines the Committee/Team Senior Member position, and describes the improved Committee/Team Leader appointment process.
- [Motion 1.2019.1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/01.2019.1%20-%20Spirit.pdf), [Motion 3.2019.1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/03.2019.1%20-%20Objectives.pdf), [Motion 4.2019.1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/04.2019.1%20-%20Board%20of%20Directors.pdf), [Motion 5.2019.1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/05.2019.1%20-%20Election%20of%20Directors.pdf), [Motion 6.2019.1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/06.2019.1%20-%20Regional%20Organizations.pdf), [Motion 8.2019.1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/08.2019.1%20-%20Delegates.pdf), [Motion 10.2019.2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2019.2%20-%20Disciplinary%20Committee.pdf), [Motion 10.2019.3](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2019.3%20-%20Ethics%20Committee.pdf), [Motion 11.2019.1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/11.2019.1%20-%20Finances.pdf), [Motion 13.2019.1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/13.2019.1%20-%20Amendments%20of%20Bylaws%20and%20Motions.pdf), [Motion 14.2019.1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/14.2019.1%20-%20Amendments%20of%20Regulations.pdf), [Motion 15.2019.1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/15.2019.1%20-%20Suspensions%20and%20other%20Sanctions.pdf), [Motion 16.2019.1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/16.2019.1%20-%20Disputes.pdf), [Motion 17.2019.1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/17.2019.1%20-%20Legal%20Liability.pdf), [Motion 18.2019.1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/18.2019.1%20-%20Dissolution.pdf): address the removal of the “External Staff” term, the following Motions are affected.

*Motions affected by other changes too are listed separately.

translation.title: WCA 决议修订获通过（2019 年 1 月）
translation.content:
经近期投票，决议修订提案已获通过。新版完整章程与决议可在[文件页面](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents) 查看，最终改动列表见[此处](https://github.com/thewca/wca-documents/pull/34/files). 自 2019 年 1 月 1 日起生效的决议整理如下：

- [决议 10.2019.1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2019.1%20-%20Competition%20Announcement%20Team.pdf): 通过决议正式设立 WCA 比赛公示组，并规定其权利和职责。
- [决议 20.2019.0](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/20.2019.0%20-%20Councils.pdf): 界定 WCA 理事会的范围。
- [决议 20.2019.1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/20.2019.1%20-%20Advisory%20Council.pdf): 正式设立 WCA 顾问理事会，并规定其权利和职责。
- [决议 2.2019.1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/02.2019.1%20-%20Definitions.pdf): 补充缺失及新增的定义，并在必要之处作出澄清。
- [决议 9.2019.1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/09.2019.1%20-%20Senior%20Delegates.pdf): 规定仅正式代表可以申请高级代表职位。
- [决议 10.2019.0](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2019.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf): 定义委员会/团队资深成员岗位，并说明改进后的委员会/团队负责人任命流程。
- [决议 1.2019.1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/01.2019.1%20-%20Spirit.pdf), [决议 3.2019.1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/03.2019.1%20-%20Objectives.pdf), [决议 4.2019.1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/04.2019.1%20-%20Board%20of%20Directors.pdf), [决议 5.2019.1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/05.2019.1%20-%20Election%20of%20Directors.pdf), [决议 6.2019.1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/06.2019.1%20-%20Regional%20Organizations.pdf), [决议 8.2019.1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/08.2019.1%20-%20Delegates.pdf), [决议 10.2019.2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2019.2%20-%20Disciplinary%20Committee.pdf), [决议 10.2019.3](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2019.3%20-%20Ethics%20Committee.pdf), [决议 11.2019.1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/11.2019.1%20-%20Finances.pdf), [决议 13.2019.1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/13.2019.1%20-%20Amendments%20of%20Bylaws%20and%20Motions.pdf), [决议 14.2019.1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/14.2019.1%20-%20Amendments%20of%20Regulations.pdf), [决议 15.2019.1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/15.2019.1%20-%20Suspensions%20and%20other%20Sanctions.pdf), [决议 16.2019.1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/16.2019.1%20-%20Disputes.pdf), [决议 17.2019.1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/17.2019.1%20-%20Legal%20Liability.pdf), [决议 18.2019.1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/18.2019.1%20-%20Dissolution.pdf): 因删除“外部工作人员”一词而作相应调整；以上决议均受此改动影响。

*同时涉及其他修改的决议已单独列出。
